blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent video generation models produce visually compelling outputs, yet their physical plausibility remains poorly measured. Physical plausibility asks whether generated objects obey geometry, kinematics, dynamics, and conservation laws. Existing benchmarks rely on coarse visual-language model judgments or target embodied world models rather than video generation itself. We introduce PVBench, a physical video benchmark that quantitatively measures the plausibility of generated videos across 46 dimensions organized into seven domains, spanning: i) instruction and semantic fidelity, ii) behavioral and causal consistency, iii) perceptual and temporal quality, iv) geometric and spatial consistency, v) material properties and field states, vi) kinematic and spatiotemporal persistence, vii) and mechanical plausibility with conservation laws. PVBench comprises 600 carefully crafted prompts, of which 30% involve physical embodied agents such as robot arms, humanoids, quadrupeds, and multi-agent systems. For challenging physically tractable dimensions, it pairs each with specialized vision models that derive verifiable, physically grounded measurements, such as object-level 6D pose, metric scale, surface normals, kinematics, and numerical conservation-law residuals. It thus avoids relying solely on subjective scoring, while supporting both text-to-video and image-to-video generation. Finally, we validate the agreement between automatic metrics and human judgments through human evaluation. Meanwhile, we evaluate mainstream open-source and closed-source models and present several insights. By releasing the benchmark, prompts, and calibration protocol, we aim to foster physically grounded video generation.
blocks.zh: 近期的视频生成模型产生了视觉上令人信服的产出,但其物理可信度仍然测量不足。 物理上的合理性询问所生成的物体是否遵守了几何学,动能学,动力学,和保护法. 现有的基准依赖于粗糙的视觉语言模型判断或目标,而不是视频生成本身。 我们采用PV Bench这一物理视频基准,从数量上衡量46个维度生成的视频的可信度,这些视频分为7个领域:(一) 教学和语义忠诚,(二) 行为和因果一致性,(三) 认知和时间质量,(四) 几何和空间一致性,(五) 物质属性和场地状态,(六) 动能和瞬息性持久性,(七) 机械功能与保护法。 PV Bench由600个精心设计的提示器组成,其中30%涉及机器人武器、人造物、四面体和多面体系统等物理内含剂。 对于具有挑战性的物理可牵引维度,它与专门视觉模型相配,这些模型得出可核查的、以物理为基础的测量结果,如物体6D级外观、度量尺度、地表常态、动能和数值保护法残基等。 因此,它避免仅仅依靠主观的分数,同时支持文本到视频和图像到视频的生成. 最后,我们确认自动衡量标准与通过人类评价作出人类判断之间的一致。 同时,我们评价主流开放源代码和封闭源代码模型,并提出若干见解。 通过发布基准、提示和校准协议,我们的目标是促进基于实体的视频生成。

blocks.en: Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Video generation technology has advanced rapidly in recent years. Large-scale Text-/Image-to-Video (T2V/I2V) models can now produce visually convincing videos and are increasingly regarded as an important foundation for world models [ 20 , 48 ] . Yet looking real does not equal obeying physical laws [ 32 ] : generated videos still frequently exhibit objects clipping through each other, vanishing out of nowhere, or wrong scales. For embodied intelligence [ 33 ] , content creation [ 4 ] , and simulation [ 5 ] , such physical errors directly undermine usability.
Therefore, how to measure the physical plausibility of generated videos is a question that video generation must answer before reaching downstream applications.
blocks.zh:
视频生成技术近年来迅速发展. 大型Text-/Image-to-Video(T2V/I2V)模型现在可以制作视觉上令人信服的视频,并日益被视为世界模型[20,48]的重要基础. 制作的影片仍然经常显示相互剪辑的物体, 对于包含的智能[33],内容创造[4],以及模拟[5],这种物理错误直接破坏可用性.
因此,如何衡量生成的视频的物理可信度是视频生成在到达下游应用之前必须回答的一个问题.

blocks.en: Existing benchmarks still cannot answer this question well. General-purpose video benchmarks [ 16 , 17 ] mainly assess semantic and perceptual quality; a video that seriously violates physical laws can still score high on these metrics as long as the picture is clear and aligned with the text. Benchmarks targeting physical plausibility have two limitations: 1) Semantic binary judgment : most works [ 2 , 14 ] rely on MLLM or human yes/no ratings, which cannot localize which physical quantity is violated, which object violates physics, let alone quantify the severity of the violation; 2) Insufficient physical-quantity coverage : existing evaluation sets usually cover only a few commonsense categories or geometric quantities in simple scenarios, yet some object-level physical quantities are crucial for downstream applications. For example, metric scale determines whether a generated video can support robot manipulation and scene reconstruction that require real dimensions, and 6D pose is the interface quantity from “watching a video” to “using a video” for motion planning and simulation initialization, which is essentially missing in existing works. Recent works have shown the trend of physical-quantity evaluation: Physics-IQ [ 32 ] indirectly characterizes motion with proxy metrics, WorldScore [ 10 ] introduces geometric measurement, but neither is yet a systematic physical-quantity evaluation framework.
blocks.zh: 现有的基准仍然不能很好地回答这个问题。 通用视频基准[16,17]主要评估语义和知觉质量;一个严重违反物理定律的视频,只要画面清晰,与文本一致,这些度量标准仍然可以得分很高. 以物理可信性为目标的基准有两个局限性: 1)语义二进制判断:大多数作品[2,14]依赖于MLLM或人类是/否的评分,这些评分不能将哪些物理量被侵犯,哪些物体违反物理,更不要说对侵权的严重程度进行量化了;2) 物理量覆盖范围不足:现有评价集通常只涵盖少数常见类别或简单情景中的几何量,然而一些物体级物理量对于下游应用至关重要. 例如,衡量尺度决定一个生成的视频是否能够支持机器人操作和需要真实维度的场景重建,6D的姿势是从“观看视频”到“使用视频”用于运动规划和模拟初始化的接口数量,这在现有的作品中基本上缺失. 近期的作品显示了物理量评价的趋势:物理-智商[32] 间接定性运动与代用度量衡,WorldScore[10]引入几何测量,但两者都不是一个系统性物理量评价框架.

blocks.en: We argue that physical plausibility should not stay at the level of semantic impression, but should be implemented as computable physical quantities and tested against physical laws . To this end, this paper proposes PVBench, a physical-plausibility benchmark for video generation models. Its contributions are threefold: 1) Systematic physical taxonomy : it organizes 46 evaluation dimensions into 7 domains, of which 25 physical dimensions span object-intrinsic properties, relations between objects and space, and object dynamics across space and time, covering most physical dimensions that have appeared in existing benchmarks; 2) Same-scene T2V/I2V paired prompt set : 600 prompt groups, each containing T2V/I2V versions of the same scene, 30% of which involve embodied-agent scenarios, and each prompt binds its target evaluation dimensions at construction time and requires the key physical quantities to be visible in the frame; 3) Physical-quantity-dominated evaluation protocol : specialized vision models extract numerical physical quantities, which are checked against physical laws and then mapped to evaluation scores, while dimensions that cannot be directly computed ( e.g. , materials, phase change, etc. ) are supplemented by MLLM scoring.
blocks.zh: 我们主张,物理合理性不应停留在语义印象的水平,而应作为可计算物理数量加以实施,并参照物理定律进行检验。 为此,本文提出了PV Bench,即视频生成模型的物理可信度基准. 其贡献有三: (1)系统物理分类法:将46个评价维度组织到7个领域,其中25个物理维度跨越物体内在特性、物体与空间之间的关系以及跨越空间和时间的物体动力学,涵盖现有基准中出现的大多数物理维度;(2)同场T2V/I2V配对的速报集:600个速报组,每个速报组包含同一场景的T2V/I2V版本,其中30%包含内含内含剂的假想,每个速报组在施工时即刻绑定其目标评价维度,并要求在框架中显示关键物理量;(3)物理量为主的评价协议:专门视觉模型提取数物理量,这些量根据物理定律加以检查,然后映射到评价分数,而无法直接计算的维度(如材料、相变等)则由MLM评分来补充。

blocks.en: Experiments show that the physical dimensions of PVBench are generally consistent with human judgments. Meanwhile, across 6 T2V and 6 I2V mainstream model configurations, the physical-layer scores are substantially lower overall than those in the semantic and perceptual layers, highlighting a persistent gap in physical plausibility. We will open-source the code and release the prompt set to foster physically grounded video generation research. We hope PVBench can push video generation from “looking good” to “physically usable”.
blocks.zh: 实验显示PV Bench的物理维度一般与人类判断一致. 同时,在6个T2V和6个I2V主流模型配置中,物理层的分数总体大大低于语义层和知觉层的分数,凸显了物理性上的持续差距. 我们将打开代码源,并发布即时集,以促进基于实体的视频生成研究. 我们希望PV Bench能够将视频生成从“看起来好”推向“实际可用”。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Overview of PVBench. (a) The benchmark comprises 46 evaluation dimensions organized into seven domains and three assessment layers: semantic, perceptual, and physical. (b) The physical layer contains 25 dimensions covering object-intrinsic properties, relations between objects and space, and object dynamics across space and time, encompassing most physical dimensions appearing in prior work. (c) PVBench uses three evaluation paradigms: physical-quantity measurement, MLLM evaluation, and a combination of both.
blocks.zh: 图1:PV Bench概览。 (a) 基准包括46个评价层面,分为7个领域和3个评估层面:语义、观念和物理。 (b) 物理层包含25个维度,涵盖物体内在特性、物体与空间之间的关系以及跨越空间和时间的物体动态,涵盖以前工作中出现的多数物理维度。 (c) PV Bench采用三个评价范式:物理数量计量、MLLM评价以及两者的组合。

blocks.en: Related Work
blocks.zh: 有关工作

blocks.en: Video Foundation Models
blocks.zh: 视频基金会模型

blocks.en:
Video generation has advanced rapidly under the diffusion paradigm [ 15 , 42 ] , with diffusion transformers [ 36 ] and flow matching [ 24 , 25 ] as the dominant architectural and training choices. Systems such as Sora [ 4 ] , Wan [ 46 ] , and HunyuanVideo 1.5 [ 51 ] now produce high-fidelity T2V and image-to-video (I2V) clips at scale, while recent models further diversify the design space. Seedance 2.0 [ 45 ] unifies text, image, audio, and video inputs in a single model, SANA-Video [ 8 ] pursues efficient long-video generation with linear attention, and MAGI-1 [ 48 ] departs from diffusion altogether to explore autoregressive video generation.
Beyond media synthesis, video generators are increasingly framed as world models [ 20 ] . Cosmos [ 33 ] builds world foundation models as digital twins of the physical world for physical AI, while interactive systems accept action inputs, ranging from latent-action environments [ 5 ] to open-domain action-controlled game generation [ 54 ] .
blocks.zh:
视频生成在传播范式[15,42]下迅速进步,传播变压器[36]和流量匹配[24,25]是主要的建筑和培训选择. Sora [4],Wan [46],HunyuanVideo 1.5 [51]等系统现在以规模生产出高纯度的T2V和图像到视频(I2V)片段,而最近的模型则进一步使设计空间多样化. 种子2.0 [45] 统一文本,图像,音频,视频输入在一个单一模型中,SANA-Video [8] 追求高效的长视频生成,具有线性关注,MAGI-1 [48] 脱离传播完全探索自动视频生成.
除了媒体合成之外,视频生成器越来越多地被设定为世界模型[20]. Cosmos [33]作为物理世界的数码双胞胎为物理AI建立世界基础模型,而交互式系统接受动作输入,从潜伏动作环境[5]到开放域动作控制的游戏生成[54].

blocks.en: Benchmarks for Video Generation
blocks.zh: 视频生成基准

blocks.en: General-purpose suites decompose video quality into perceptual and semantic metrics computed with pretrained perception models or MLLMs as judges. VBench and VBench++ [ 16 , 17 ] cover temporal consistency, motion smoothness, and text-video alignment, while EvalCrafter [ 26 ] and T2V-CompBench [ 44 ] aggregate human-preference and compositional-alignment metrics. VBench-2.0 [ 56 ] moves toward intrinsic faithfulness by adding physics, commonsense, and human-fidelity dimensions. Its physics checks remain coarse, however, consisting mainly of VLM question answering on state changes (mechanics, thermotics, material), with feature-matching geometry for multi-view consistency. More recent world-model benchmarks broaden the evaluation scope beyond visual quality. HappyWorld-Bench [ 1 ] evaluates video, spatial, and embodied world models, with an emphasis on consistency and responsiveness during exploration, interaction, and modification.
blocks.zh: 通用套房将视频质量分解成以预先训练的感知模型或MLLMs作为评委计算出来的感知和语义度量。 V Bench和V Bench++ [16,17] 涵盖时间一致性,运动光滑度,以及文本-视频对齐性,而EvalCrrafter [26] 和 T2V-Comp Bench [44] 汇总的人类偏好和组成-对齐度量. V Bench -2.0 [56] 通过增加物理,常识,和人与人之间的忠诚维度,走向内在的忠诚. 然而,它的物理检查仍然粗糙,主要包括针对状态变化的VLM问题回答(机械学,热学,材料),具有特征匹配的几何学,以达到多视图的一致性. 最近的世界模式基准将评价范围扩大到视觉质量之外。 HappyWorld-Bench [1]评价视频,空间,和体现的世界模型,强调在探索,互动,修改过程中的一致性和响应性.

blocks.en: A parallel line of work targets physical plausibility directly. VideoPhy-2 [ 2 ] and PhyWorldBench [ 14 ] rely on human or MLLM semantic judgments over action-centric activities and diverse prompt categories; PhyGenBench [ 28 ] scores 27 physical principles with a hierarchical VLM evaluator; WorldModelBench [ 22 ] rates five physical laws as binary outcomes; Physics-IQ [ 32 ] measures motion-mask overlap on real-scene continuation, with metrics the authors acknowledge remain proxies rather than direct physical quantities. WorldScore [ 10 ] is the most quantitative, reconstructing camera trajectories with DROID-SLAM [ 47 ] and computing reprojection error, dense depth, and optical-flow AEPE. However, these physical-plausibility benchmarks are still limited to semantic judgments and coarse-grained categories, and the few quantitative ones measure only camera-centric geometry. To address these challenges, we evaluate generated videos through numerical physical quantities extracted by specialized models and checked against physical laws.
blocks.zh: 平行的工作线直接以物理上的合理性为目标. VideoPhy-2 [2] 和 PhyWorld Bench [14] 依靠人或MLLM语义判断,而不是动作中心活动和多样的即时分类; PhyGen Bench [28] 得分27个物理原理,并设有一个等级的VLM评价员; WorldModel Bench [22] 将五个物理定律评为二进制结果; Physics-IQ [32] 测量运动-掩码在真景续作上的重叠,而作者承认的度量仍然是代数而不是直接物理量. WorldScore [10] 是最量化的,用 DROID-SLAM [47] 重建相机轨迹,并计算再投影误差,密度深度,光学流 AEPE. 然而,这些物理可辨性基准仍然局限于语义判断和粗粗的分类,少数量化的基准只测量以相机为中心的几何. 为了应对这些挑战,我们通过专门模型提取的实物数量,并根据物理定律对生成的视频进行评估。

blocks.en: Methodology
blocks.zh: 方法

blocks.en: PVBench Evaluation System
blocks.zh: PV 奔驰评价系统

blocks.en: PVBench evaluates generated videos along 46 dimensions. These 46 dimensions are organized into 7 domains and span three assessment layers: semantic, perceptual, and physical. The physical layer encompasses 4 domains with 25 dimensions in total, which are further divided into three families: object-intrinsic physical properties, relations between objects and space, and object dynamics across space and time, covering most common physical quantities. The overall framework is shown in Fig. 1 ; the complete correspondence is given in Appendix A , Table A1 .
blocks.zh: PV Bench评价了46维的生成视频. 这46个维度分为7个领域,跨越三个评估层:语义、观念和物理。 物理层包含4个域,共25个维度,进一步分为3个系:物体内物理特性,物体与空间的关系,以及跨越空间和时间的物体动力学,涵盖最常见的物理量. 图1列出了总体框架;附录A表A1列出了完整的对应情况。

blocks.en: PVBench turns “physical plausibility” from a qualitative question into a numerically testable one. Except for dimensions that are difficult to quantify, each physical dimension is paired with a computable physical quantity and a physical-law consistency criterion. Semantic and perceptual dimensions follow or adapt existing paradigms, allowing the physical score to be interpreted jointly with semantic fidelity and visual quality.
blocks.zh: PV Bench将“物理上的合理性”从定性问题变为数字上可以验证的问题。 除难以量化的维度外,每个物理维度均与可计算物理量和物理法一致性标准对齐. 语义和知觉维度遵循或调整了现有的范式,使物理分数能够与语义忠贞和视觉品质共同解释.

blocks.en: Compared with prior works, PVBench covers physical dimensions more comprehensively, evaluates primarily through quantitative computation of physical quantities, and uses MLLM to supplement dimensions that are hard to quantify.
blocks.zh: 与之前的作品相比,PV Bench更全面地涵盖物理维度,主要通过物理量的定量计算来评价,并使用MLLM来补充难以量化的维度.

blocks.en: Prompt Design for Physical Plausibility Evaluation
blocks.zh: 物理性能评价的快速设计

blocks.en: Diverse Dedicated Scene Construction. Prompts fall into three categories: 1) for each of the 46 evaluation dimensions, 5 tailored prompts are designed; 2) related dimensions are paired in all 23 dimension pairs, each pair corresponding to 10 hybrid prompts; 3) embodied agents are injected, together with controlled occlusion, camera motion, and other visual confounders, as a high-difficulty supplement. The three categories total 600 prompt groups, each containing a one-to-one T2V and I2V variant, of which 30% involve embodied-agent scenarios (Fig. 3 ).
blocks.zh: 多元专用景区建筑. 提示分为三类: 1)针对46个评价维度中的每个,设计了5个特制的提示符;2)在所有23个维度对称中,相关维度对称,每对对应10个混合提示符;3)与受控的隔离,相机运动,以及其他视觉交错者一起,作为高难度的辅助剂进行注入. 三类共600种速成组,每类包含一对一的T2V和I2V变体,其中30%涉及含剂假想(图3)。

blocks.en: LLM-Assisted Prompt Construction. Each prompt group is built in three steps: 1) given the target dimensions and scene specification, draft the prompt with GPT-5.6 Sol [ 34 ] , explicitly instantiating objects, multi-stage actions, and observability constraints; 2) each draft is manually screened for physical plausibility, visual feasibility, and unambiguous observability, modified or discarded if necessary; 3) the reference image of the I2V variant is synthesized by the GPT-image-2 model [ 35 ] from the first-frame description of the prompt, so that the T2V and I2V variants share the same initial scene (Fig. 2 ).
blocks.zh: LLM-Assisted Supplement Building. (原始内容存档于2018-09-21). 每个提示组分为三个步骤: 1)鉴于目标尺寸和场景规格,与GPT-5.6 Sol [34]一起起草提示,明确即时物体,多阶段动作,以及可观察性约束;2)每个提示都是人工筛选的,以了解物理上的合理性,视觉可行性,以及清晰的可观察性,必要时修改或丢弃;3)I2V变体的参考图像由GPT-image-2模型[35]从提示的第一帧描述中合成,使T2V和I2V变体共享相同的初始场景(图2).

blocks.en: Figure 2 : PVBench data curation. (a) Design of the target dimensions and scene. (b) Construction of prompts through multiple rounds of MLLM assistance and human verification. (c) Generation of T2V and I2V videos.
blocks.zh: 图2:PV Bench数据目录。 (a) 设计目标尺寸和场景。 (b) 通过多轮最低劳动报酬援助和人力核查来建造导火线。 (c) 制作T2V和I2V录像。

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Prompt statistics of PVBench. The figure provides an integrated characterization of the PVBench prompt set, summarizing its dimension distribution, length variation, physical scene coverage, and key vocabulary.
blocks.zh: 图3: PV Bench的即时统计。 该图提供了PV Bench 提示集的综合特征,概括了其尺寸分布,长度变化,物理场景覆盖,以及关键词汇.

blocks.en: Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 评价协议

blocks.en: Hierarchical Metrics of PVBench
blocks.zh: PV Bench的分级计量

blocks.en: PVBench metrics have three layers: semantic, perceptual, and physical. They are subdivided by evaluation target into 7 domains for a total of 46 dimensions. Table 1 summarizes the dimensions covered by each specialized evaluation model.
blocks.zh: PV Bench 度量衡有三层:语义,知觉,和物理. 它们按评价目标细分为总共46个层面的7个领域。 表1汇总了每个专门评价模式所涉及的层面。

blocks.en: Semantic layer examines the consistency between the generated video and the conditioning information and commonsense logic, covering 2 domains and 14 dimensions. Condition and semantic fidelity (CSF) measures whether the video is faithful to the input condition, covering instruction following, attribute correctness, spatial relations, style, negation, scene, camera motion, and reference-condition following. Behavioral, causal, and commonsense consistency (BC) measures whether actions and timing unfold as instructed, and whether behavior conforms to physical, biological, and social commonsense.
blocks.zh: 语义层审查生成的视频与调制信息和常识逻辑的一致性,涵盖2个域和14个维度. 条件和语义忠诚度(CSF)衡量视频是否忠实于输入条件,涵盖以下指令,属性正确性,空间关系,风格,否定,场景,相机运动,以及后面的参考条件. 行为、因果和常识一致性(BC)衡量行动是否按照指示进行,行为是否符合物理、生物和社会常识。

blocks.en: The perceptual layer , termed Perceptual and Temporal Quality (PTQ), evaluates the visual quality of video frames and temporal dynamics across 7 dimensions. It covers subject consistency, aesthetic quality, motion smoothness, temporal flickering, dynamic degree, background and imaging quality. The semantic and perceptual layers follow or adapt existing evaluation paradigms, so that the physical-layer score can be interpreted jointly with semantic fidelity and image quality.
blocks.zh: 感知层称为感知和时间质量(PTQ),评价视频帧的视觉质量和时间动态跨越7个维度. 它涵盖主题的一致性、美学质量、运动光滑度、时间闪烁、动态程度、背景和成像质量。 语义和知觉层遵循或调整了现有的评价范式,从而可以将物理层的分数与语义的忠诚度和图像质量结合起来解释.

blocks.en: Physical layer is the core of PVBench, covering 4 domains and 25 dimensions, divided by the type of physical quantity measured. Geometric and spatial consistency (GS) evaluates the spatial self-consistency of geometric quantities such as depth, normals, shape, scale, pose, spatial relations, and cross-frame geometry. Material properties and field states (MFS) evaluates material attributes and field quantities such as deformation, material, thermal radiation, light/shadow, magnetic/electric, and phase change. Kinematics and spatiotemporal persistence (KP) evaluates kinematic quantities such as displacement, velocity, and angular velocity, as well as spatiotemporal persistence properties such as motion continuity and object permanence. Mechanical plausibility and conservation laws (MC) evaluates mechanical and conserved quantities such as static stability, dynamic effects of forces, momentum conservation, and energy conservation.
blocks.zh: 物理层是PV Bench的核心,涵盖4个域和25维,按所测量的物理数量类型划分. 几何与空间一致性(GS)评价几何量的空间自相容性,如深度,常态,形状,尺度,姿势,空间关系,以及跨帧几何等. 材料属性和场态(MFS)评价材料属性和场量,如变形,材料,热辐射,光/影,磁/电,以及相位变化. 动因学和动因学持久性(KP)评价运动量,如移位、速度和角速度,以及运动连续性和物体持久性等动因学持久性。 机械合理性和节能法(MC)对静态稳定性,动力动态效应,动力节能,节能等机械和节能量进行评估.

blocks.zh: 表1:每个专门评价模式所涉及的层面。 维度名称缩写为代码以保存空间;完整的对应文本请参见附录.

blocks.en: From Specialized Models to Physical Quantities
blocks.zh: 从专用模型到物理量

blocks.en: Where quantification is possible, each physical dimension is paired with a specialized vision foundation model that outputs numerical physical quantities rather than semantic judgments; this is the fundamental difference between PVBench and previous physical benchmarks. But not all physical quantities can be directly quantified, in which case MLLM-assisted judgment is introduced. By evaluation method, the physical evaluation of PVBench is thus divided into three paradigms: i) specialized-model quantitative evaluation ; ii) specialized-model measurement with MLLM judgment ; iii) pure MLLM semantic scoring . Among the 25 physical dimensions, 17 are evaluated purely numerically, 4 rely on pure MLLM scoring, and 4 use hybrid measurement.
blocks.zh: 在有可能量化的情况下,每个物理维度都与专门的视觉基础模型配对,该模型输出物理量而不是语义判断;这是PV Bench和以往物理基准之间的根本区别. 但并非所有物理量都可以直接量化,在这种情况下,引入了MLLM辅助判决. 通过评价方法,PV Bench的物理评价因此被分为三个范式:(一) 专业模型定量评价;(二) 具有MLLM判断力的专门模型测量;(三) 纯MLLM语义评分。 在25个物理维度中,17个是纯数字评价,4个是依靠纯MLLM评分,4个是使用混合测量.

blocks.en: Score Mapping
blocks.zh: 分数映射

blocks.en: Physical quantity values are mapped to a 1 to 5 score through thresholds, which are manually set according to the reasonable range of the physical quantity; their fit to human judgment is verified by the human validation in Section 3.4 . Each dimension first takes the mean over its samples, then the domain and overall scores are obtained by equal-weight averaging across dimensions, avoiding dimensions with more samples from dominating the total. In the final report, scores are uniformly linearly mapped to a percentile scale.The specific physical quantities, formulas, specialized models used, and threshold-mapping details for each physical dimension are given in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 物理量值通过阈值映射到1至5分,这些阈值根据物理量的合理范围人工设定;其与人类判断的相容性由3.4节中的人类验证验证. 每个维度首先取平均值超过其样本,然后域和总体分数通过不同维度的等重平均值获得,避免了在总数中占优势的更多样本的维度. 在最后报告中,分数被统一线性地映射到百分位比例。 附录D列出了每个物理维度的具体物理量、公式、所使用的专门模型和阈值绘图细节。

blocks.en: Human Alignment For Benchmark Validation
blocks.zh: 人为基准验证

blocks.en: To verify the consistency between evaluator scores and human judgments, we selected three T2V models and 5 evaluation prompts per physical dimension for manual annotation and scoring. For each evaluation dimension, we wrote detailed guidelines and examples, and annotators were trained first to fully understand the metric definition. Each sample was independently scored by 10 annotators and averaged. The results of this experiment are presented in Section 4.3 .
blocks.zh: 为了核实评价者得分与人类判断的一致性,我们选择了三个T2V模型和每个物理维的5个评价提示,用于人工注释和评分. 就每个评价层面而言,我们编写了详细的准则和实例,首先培训了注释员,以充分了解衡量标准的定义。 每个样本都由10名注释员独立评分并平均评分. 这一试验的结果载于第4.3节。

blocks.en: Novelty: From Semantic Judgment to Physical-State Evaluation
blocks.zh: 小说:从语义判断到实体国家评价

blocks.en: PVBench differs from prior benchmarks primarily in the unit of evaluation: instead of asking whether a video looks physically plausible, it estimates observable physical states and evaluates their consistency with prompt-conditioned physical constraints and laws. This shift from holistic semantic judgment to computable physical-state evaluation is the core novelty of PVBench. In contrast to prior video benchmarks, which either emphasize semantic and perceptual quality or assess physical plausibility mainly through human or MLLM judgments, binary outcomes, proxy metrics, or camera-centric geometry, PVBench makes physical plausibility measurable at the level of object states and physical laws.
blocks.zh: PV Bench与先前主要在评价单元中的基准不同:它不问视频是否看上去在物理上是可信的,而是估计了可观察到的物理状态,并评价了这些状态是否与迅速有条件的物理约束和法律相符。 这种从整体语义判断向可计算物理状态评价的转变是PV Bench的核心新颖性. 与以前强调语义和知觉质量的视频基准或主要通过人或MLLM判断,二进制结果,代理度量衡,或以相机为中心的几何来评估物理可信度相比,PV Bench使物理可信度在物体状态和物理定律层面可以测量.

blocks.en: Experiments
blocks.zh: 实验

blocks.en: Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 实验设置

blocks.en: Evaluated models. We evaluate 6 mainstream video generation models, covering open-source and closed-source systems: MiniMax H3 [ 31 ] , SANA-Video 2.0 [ 7 ] , Wan2.1 [ 46 ] and Wan2.2 [ 46 ] , Seedance 2.5 [ 6 , 45 ] , and LingBot-Video [ 27 ] , for a total of 6 T2V and 6 I2V configurations. The specific list is in Table 2 .
blocks.zh: 评估模型。 我们评价6种主流视频生成模式,涵盖开源和闭源系统:MiniMax H3 [31],SANA-Video 2.0 [7],Wan2.1 [46]和Wan2.2 [46],种子2.5 [6,45],LingBot-Video [27],共计6台T2V和6台I2V配置. 具体名单见表2。

blocks.en: Generation protocol. Each model generates all 600 prompt groups one by one; T2V and I2V variants use text and reference-image conditions respectively. All models use a unified output specification: 720p resolution, 10-second duration, and a fixed random seed. Full details of the generation parameters are provided in Appendix F .
blocks.zh: 生成协议。 每个模型都逐个生成所有600个快速组;T2V和I2V变体分别使用文本和参考图像条件. 所有模型都使用统一的输出规格:720p分辨率,10秒持续,以及固定的随机种子. 生成参数的全部详情见附录F。

blocks.en: Evaluation protocol. The generated videos are uniformly evaluated according to the protocol in Section 3.3 ; all evaluators use fixed versions and weights to ensure reproducibility of the experiment. Final scores are uniformly reported on a percentile scale.
blocks.zh: 评估协议。 生成的视频根据第3.3节中的协议得到统一评价;所有评价人员都使用固定版本和权重来确保实验的可复制性. 最后得分统一按百分数比例报告。

blocks.en: Main Results and Cross-Layer Model Behavior
blocks.zh: 主要结果和跨激光模型行为

blocks.en: Table 2 summarizes the current percentile scores of the 6 T2V and 6 I2V models across all seven domains. Different models show clear capability differences across the seven metrics. Fig. 4 further visualizes the score distribution of each model across the seven domains and the three-layer structure with radar and bar charts.
blocks.zh: 表2汇总了所有七个领域6个T2V和6个I2V模型的目前百分数。 不同的模型显示,这7个衡量标准的能力差异明显。 图4用雷达和条形图进一步可视化地显示每个模型在7个领域和三层结构上的得分分布。

Within each configuration, the highest score for each metric is boldfaced and the second-highest is marked with an asterisk. Open- and closed-source models are grouped separately; closed-source model rows are shaded light blue.
blocks.zh: 表2:被评价模型的PV Bench得分. 分数按百分数报告。 在每个配置中,每个度量标准的最高分被粗体标出,第二高分被标出星号. 开源模型和闭源模型分别分组;闭源模型行为荫光蓝.

blocks.en: Figure 4 : PVBench results for six T2V and six I2V configurations. The figure presents seven-domain radar plots for T2V and I2V together with heatmaps of semantic-, perceptual-, and physical-layer scores and the overall score, rounded to integers. Physical-layer scores are markedly lower than semantic- and perceptual-layer scores; Seedance 2.5 performs best overall, followed by MiniMax H3.
blocks.zh: 图4:PV Bench对六个T2V和六个I2V配置的结果. 图中列出了T2V和I2V的七域雷达图,以及语义、知觉和物理层分数的热图和总分数,四舍五入为整数。 物理层次的分数明显低于语义层次和知觉层次的分数;种子2.5整体表现最好,其次是MiniMax H3.

blocks.en: Semantic and Perceptual Layer Results. Overall, the semantic and perceptual layers can distinguish different models in condition following, behavior understanding, and visual quality, but the three do not show a completely consistent ranking. For example, SANA-Video 2.0 in the T2V configuration scores 58.2 in perception and temporal quality (PTQ), but only 39.0 in behavioral and causal commonsense (BC). This illustrates that a model can produce reasonably polished frames and temporal dynamics while remaining weak in action causality and commonsense reasoning; perceptual quality and behavioral plausibility are not equivalent. The semantic and perceptual layer results provide a reference for the physical-layer analysis.
blocks.zh: 语义和认知层结果。 总体而言,语义层和知觉层可以在条件跟随,行为理解,以及视觉质量上区分不同的模型,但三层并不显示完全一致的排名. 例如,T2V配置中的SANA-Video 2.0在感知和时间质量(PTQ)方面评分58.2分,但在行为和因果共性(BC)方面则只有39.0分. 这说明一个模型可以产生合理的抛光框架和时间动态,同时在动作因果关系和常识推理方面仍然薄弱;知觉质量和行为合理性并不相等. 语义和知觉层结果为物理层分析提供了参考.

blocks.en: Physical Layer Results. Overall, the scores of geometric space and kinematic persistence are higher than those of material field states and mechanical conservation, indicating that generated videos maintain visible geometric structure and general motion trajectories relatively stably, while material field states and mechanical/conservation relations are more difficult. The low-score distribution of mechanical conservation especially shows that visual continuity or action completion alone is insufficient to guarantee that the result conforms to mechanical laws.
blocks.zh: 物理层结果。 总体而言,几何空间和运动持久性的分数比材料场状态和机械保存的分数要高,表明生成的视频保持可见几何结构和一般运动轨迹相对稳定,而材料场状态和机械/保守关系则比较困难. 机械保存的低分数分布尤其表明,光是视觉连续性或动作完成不足以保证结果符合机械定律.

blocks.en: Insight 1. Visual quality is not equivalent to physical plausibility. Although mainstream models can score highly on semantic and perceptual metrics, their physical-layer scores are generally lower. Some models that lead in visual quality and semantic fidelity rank lower physically, showing that visual impression or semantic alignment alone does not establish physical plausibility.
blocks.zh: 透视 1. 视觉品质不等同于物理可信度. 虽然主流模型可以在语义和知觉度量上获得很高的分数,但其物理层分数一般较低. 一些在视觉质量和语义忠诚度方面领先的模型在物理上排名较低,表明仅凭视觉印象或语义对齐并不能确立物理上的可信度.

blocks.en: Insight 2. Models remain weak at mechanics and conservation laws. Unlike geometry and general motion, mechanical conservation jointly involves object trajectories, interactions, and energy or momentum relations, demanding stronger spatiotemporal modeling. Scores remain low across models, revealing deficiencies in collisions, forces, and energy changes.
blocks.zh: 透视 2. 在机械和养护法方面,模式仍然薄弱。 与几何学和一般运动不同,机械保护共同涉及物体的轨迹,相互作用,以及能量或动力关系,要求更强的瞬态模型. 各种模型的得分仍然很低,揭示了碰撞、力量和能量变化方面的缺陷。

blocks.en: Supplementary Analysis
blocks.zh: 补充分析

blocks.en: Embodied Samples and High-Difficulty Supplemental Subset. We merge prompts tagged with embodied agents, occlusion, visual clutter, or camera motion into a high-difficulty supplemental subset, and compare it with the normal subset without such tags. Table 3 reports the physical-layer macro-average scores of the two subsets. Among T2V, 5 of 6 models drop on the supplemental subset, with an average relative drop of about 7.1%; among I2V, 5 of 6 models drop, with an average relative drop of about 10.9%.
blocks.zh: 健康样本和高难度补充子集. 我们把标有内含物剂的提示, 隐蔽,视觉杂乱, 或相机运动, 合并成一个高难度的补充子集, 并将其与普通子集比较, 没有这样的标记。 表3报告两个子集的物理层宏观平均分数. 在T2V中,6个模型中有5个在补充子集上下降,平均相对下降约7.1%;在I2V中,6个模型中有5个下降,平均相对下降约10.9%。

blocks.en: Table 3 : Physical-layer scores on normal and high-difficulty subsets.
blocks.zh: 表3:物理层在普通和高难度子集上的分数.

blocks.en: Table 4 : Correlation between automatic scores and human ratings by domain.
blocks.zh: 表4:按领域划分的自动分数与人类分数之间的关联.

blocks.zh: 表5:MiniMax H3:T2V对I2V.

blocks.en: Insight 3. The physical performance of most models drops in complex scenes. Complex scene factors increase the burden of target retention, structure recovery, and dynamic reasoning, although models differ in their sensitivity to these factors.
blocks.zh: 透视 3. 大多数模型的物理性能在复杂场景中下降. 复杂的场景因素增加了目标保留,结构恢复和动态推理的负担,尽管模型对这些因素的敏感性不同.

blocks.en: Human Alignment Validation. We used 3 T2V models, 25 physical dimensions, and 5 prompts per dimension for human validation. Each sample was independently scored by 10 annotators and averaged; the inter-annotator agreement of the average scores from the 10 annotators is high (ICC(2,k) = 0.89) [ 41 ] . Table 4 reports the correlation between automatic evaluation scores and human scores by the four physical-layer domains (three models merged). The Spearman correlation coefficients [ 43 ] of the four domains are between 0.660 and 0.805 (total 0.772), and the Kendall coefficients [ 19 ] are between 0.528 and 0.692 (total 0.643), indicating that the automatic evaluation results maintain generally high consistency with human judgments in the physical layer. Per-dimension human-alignment results are reported in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 人类对齐验证. 我们使用了3个T2V模型, 25个物理维度, 和每个维度的5个促进器进行人类验证。 每个样本均由10位注释者独立评分,并平均评分;10位注释者平均分的注释者之间一致(ICC(2k)=0.89)[41]. 表4按四个物理层域(三个模型合并)报告自动评价分数与人类分数的相互关系. 4个域中的斯皮尔曼相关系数[43]在0.660至0.805(共计0.772)之间,肯德尔系数[19]在0.528至0.692(共计0.643)之间,表明自动评价结果与物理层中的人类判断总体上保持高度一致. 附录B中报告了人与人的分化结果。

blocks.en: T2V vs. I2V: the Role of First-Frame Prior. To analyze the role of the first-frame prior, we first compare the T2V and I2V configurations of MiniMax H3. Table 5 shows that I2V scores higher than T2V in both the semantic and perceptual layers, but the physical-layer results do not improve synchronously (Fig. 5 ). I2V improves by 3.4 percentage points in material field states and is roughly flat in kinematic persistence, but drops by 3.7 and 5.2 percentage points in geometric space and mechanical conservation respectively. Per dimension, I2V improves more noticeably in light-shadow temporal consistency and magnetic-electric interaction, while depth, energy conservation, and object permanence scores drop. Thus, the first-frame prior does not affect different physical dimensions consistently. We report the paired differences for all six models in Appendix C.1 .
blocks.zh: T2V vs. I2V: First-Frame Preform. (原始内容存档于2018-09-22). 为了分析前面第一个帧的作用,我们首先比较了MiniMax H3的T2V和I2V配置. 表5显示,I2V在语义层和知觉层的得分都高于T2V,但物理层的成绩并没有同步改善(图5). I2V在物质场状态下提高了3.4个百分点,在运动持久性方面大致平坦,但在几何空间和机械保护方面分别下降了3.7和5.2个百分点. 每个维度,I2V在光影时间一致性和磁电相互作用方面都有较显著的改善,而深度,节能和物体的持久性得分则下降. 因此,前一个框架并不一贯影响不同的物理维度。 我们报告附录C.1中所有六个模型的配对差异。

blocks.en: Insight 4. The first-frame prior mainly improves condition following and perceptual quality, not all physical quantities. The first-frame prior can constrain the appearance of the initial scene and condition following, but cannot guarantee that subsequent geometry, motion, and mechanical relations remain physically reasonable.
blocks.zh: 透视 4. 前面的第一帧主要改善跟随条件和知觉质量,而不是所有物理量. 前面的第一帧可以限制最初场景的出现和随后的状况,但不能保证之后的几何,运动,和机械关系保持物理上的合理性.

blocks.zh: 图5:部分I2V的视觉比较 模特儿们 对代表性I2V生成结果进行跨选定模型的定性比较,突出物理可信度(如几何,材料,运动,保存)的差异.

blocks.en: Ablation Studies for PVBench
blocks.zh: PV Bench 读取研究

blocks.en: Table 6 : Pairwise consistency across VLM backends.
blocks.zh: 表6:VLM后端的对等一致性。

blocks.en: Table 7 : Discriminability and human agreement of physical-quantity and MLLM scores.
blocks.zh: 表7:物质数量和最低劳动报酬的可歧视性和人类同意性。

blocks.en: Different VLM Backends. We replace the VLM backend of the evaluator with Qwen3.5-9B [ 38 ] , Qwen3.8-27B [ 39 ] , or InternVL3.5-8B [ 50 ] , and compare the consistency of their scores. The pairwise Spearman correlations range from 0.71 to 0.84, indicating high agreement. This suggests that the evaluation is robust to the choice of VLM backend. We use Qwen3.8-27B by default.
blocks.zh: 不同的 VLM 语言 后结. 我们用 Quen3.5-9B [38], Quen3.8-27B [39], 或 InternVL3.5-8B [50] 替换评价员的 VLM 后端,并比较他们的分数的一致性. 双向Spearman的关联性介于0.71到0.84之间,表明高度一致. 这表明评价对于VLM后端的选择是强有力的. 我们默认使用Quen3.8-27B.

blocks.en: Discriminability: Numerical Physical Quantities vs. MLLM Semantic Scores. For the same physical dimensions, we compare scores from specialized numerical models with direct MLLM scores. Numerical scores have higher global entropy (2.25 vs. 1.12) and inter-dimension variance (1.05 vs. 0.14). MLLM scores are often saturated, with 73.7% at the maximum. Against human ratings, numerical scores reach a Spearman correlation of 0.84, compared with 0.14 for MLLM scores. These results show that physical-quantity scoring is both more discriminative and more aligned with human judgments (Table 7 ).
blocks.zh: 歧义:数体量对MLLM语义分数. 对于相同的物理维度,我们比较专业数字模型的分数和直接的MLLM分数. 数值分数具有较高的全球 en(2.25对1.12)和二元间差(1.05对0.14). MLLM分数常饱和,最高时为73.7%. 与人类的评分相比,数字分数达到了0.84的斯皮尔曼相关性,而MLLM分数则为0.14. 这些结果表明,物质数量评分既更具歧视性,也更符合人类的判断(表7)。

blocks.en: Insight 5. Physical-quantity computation provides a more reliable evaluation signal than semantic scoring. Unlike MLLM semantic scores, which tend to saturate and diverge from human judgment, numerical physical quantities offer a more discriminative and human-aligned basis for assessing physical plausibility. This suggests that future benchmarks should prioritize computable physical measurements over language-based semantic judgments.
blocks.zh: 透视 5. 物理数量计算提供了比语义评分更可靠的评价信号。 与MLLM语义分数倾向于饱和和和偏离人类判断不同,数字物理量为评估物理可信度提供了更具有歧视性和人与人一致的基础. 这表明,未来基准应优先于基于语言的语义判断,优先考虑可计算物理测量。

blocks.en: Table 8 : Evaluator threshold calibration. Default thresholds are boldfaced.
blocks.zh: 表8:评价员阈值校准。 默认阈值为粗体.

blocks.en: Threshold Calibration. We calibrate two key evaluator thresholds: SAM3 [ 30 ] detection confidence and trajectory object area. As shown in Table 8 , the PVBench thresholds of 0.10 and 0.1% perform best in both coverage and Spearman correlation with human scores, whereas 0.50 and 0.50% perform worst on both measures.
blocks.zh: 极限校准. 我们校准了两个关键的评估阈值:SAM3[30]探测置信度和轨迹物体区. 如表8所示,0.10%和0.1%的光电奔驰阈值在覆盖率和斯皮尔曼人与人类的得分关系方面表现最好,而0.5和0.50%在这两种衡量标准上表现最差。

blocks.en: Physical-Layer Domain Ablation. To examine how each physical-layer domain contributes to the overall physical score, we perform a leave-one-out ablation on the four domains (GS, MFS, KP, MC) using the results in Table 2 . For each model, we recompute the physical-layer average after removing one domain. Averaged over the six T2V models, the full physical-layer score is 38.5. Removing MC raises the average to 43.4, and removing MFS raises it to 41.9, whereas removing GS or KP decreases it to 35.0 and 33.6, respectively. This shows that MC and MFS are the main factors pulling down the overall physical score, while GS and KP contribute relatively higher scores. The consistently low MC scores further indicate that current models are generally weak in mechanics and conservation laws. These results support reporting the four physical domains separately, as they reveal distinct weaknesses across different aspects of physical plausibility.
blocks.zh: 物理-Layer域征. 为了审查每个物理层域如何对整体物理分数作出贡献,我们利用表2中的结果,对四个域(GS、MFS、KP、MC)进行一次一停一停。 对于每个模型,在移除一个域后,我们重算物理层平均值. 平均超过6台T2V型机车,全物理层得分38.5分. 取消MC将平均值提高到43.4,取消MFS将平均值提高到41.9,而取消GS或KP则分别降低到35.0和33.6。 这表明MC和MFS是拉低整体物理分数的主要因素,而GS和KP贡献的分数相对较高. MC的得分一直很低,这进一步表明目前的模型在力学和养护法方面普遍薄弱。 这些结果支持分别报告四个物理领域,因为它们揭示了物理可行性不同方面的明显弱点。

blocks.en: Conclusion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en: Video generation looks increasingly realistic, yet its physical plausibility remains poorly measured. Existing evaluations rely on semantic binary judgments or camera-centric geometry, and cannot reduce physical plausibility to computable, testable quantities. We propose PVBench, a physical-quantity-driven benchmark that extracts numerical measurements with specialized vision models, checks them against physical laws, uses same-scene T2V/I2V paired prompts, and resorts to MLLM scoring only for hard-to-quantify dimensions. Our key finding is that numerical physical-quantity scores are more discriminative than MLLM semantic scores and highly consistent with human judgments, enabling more reliable and quantifiable evaluation. We hope PVBench becomes a quantifiable yardstick for physically plausible video generation.
blocks.zh: 视频的生成看起来越来越现实,但其物理可信度仍然测量不足。 现有的评价依赖于语义二进制判断或以相机为中心的几何学,不能降低物理上可计算,可测试的数量. 我们提出PV Bench这个物理-数量驱动的基准,它用专门视觉模型提取数值测量,对照物理定律加以检查,使用同场T2V/I2V对对的提示,并且只针对难以量化的维度使用MLLM评分. 我们的主要发现是,数字物理数量分数比MLLM语义分数更具歧视性,并且与人类判断高度一致,能够进行更可靠和量化的评价。 我们希望PV Bench成为可量化的尺度 来计算物理上可信的视频生成。

blocks.en: Limitations and Future Work. The evaluation depends on specialized vision models and skips only a small number of samples for unobservable cases; material and phase-change dimensions still use MLLM scoring. We only ablate the VLM backend, and a full ablation of the specialized evaluators is left for future work. Moreover, the current evaluation largely relies on checking consistency with physical laws and, except for a few dimensions, lacks ground-truth references. More robust tracking and finer physical quantities will improve coverage. In future work, we plan to build ground-truth references for conditional image-to-video (CI2V) models using physics engines and other simulation tools to enable more direct evaluation. We will also expand the benchmark as compute and open-source models grow.
blocks.zh: 限制和今后的工作。 评价依赖于专业的视觉模型,只跳过少数无法观察的样本;材料和相变维度仍然使用MLLM评分. 我们只放弃VLM的后端,而专业评价员的完全放弃则留给今后的工作。 此外,目前的评价主要依靠检查实体法是否一致,而且除了几个方面外,没有提及地面真相。 更强有力的跟踪和精细的物理数量将提高覆盖面。 在今后的工作中,我们计划利用物理引擎和其他模拟工具,为有条件的图像到视频模型建立地面实况参考,以便能够进行更直接的评价。 随着计算和开源模型的增长,我们还将扩大基准。

blocks.en: Per-frame 3D point clouds reconstructed by VGGT- Ω \Omega ; after Kabsch alignment [ 18 ] of cross-frame point clouds, the normalized Chamfer distance measures shape cross-frame self-consistency; non-standard geometry is semantically judged by Qwen3.8-27B. Higher self-consistency means more consistent shape.
blocks.zh: 每帧3D点云由VGGT-ship complete\Omega ;在交叉帧点云的Kabsch对齐[18]后,交配的Chamfer距离度量成型跨帧自我一致性;非标准几何由Qwen3.8-27B进行整体判断. 更高的自我一致性意味着更一致的形状.

blocks.en: Metric scale prior provided by Depth Anything 3, combined with the object size segmented by SAM 3, Qwen3.8-27B judges whether the object size falls in a reasonable range; the more reasonable, the higher the score.
blocks.zh: 深度 Anything 3 先前提供的量表,与 SAM 3 所分割的对象大小结合,Quen3.8-27B 判断对象大小是否在合理范围内下降;越合理,得分越高.

blocks.en: For multiple views of the same scene (multiple frames produced by camera motion), VGGT- Ω \Omega reconstructs each separately, and the reprojection error and geometric self-consistency residual are computed to measure whether the 3D structure is consistent across views. Smaller residual is better.
blocks.zh: 对于同一场景的多个视图(由相机运动生成的多帧),VGGT-ship = omega 分别对齐,再投影误差和几何自相容余量是用来衡量三维结构是否在视图之间一致的. 更小的残留更好。

blocks.en: VGGT- Ω \Omega estimates the cross-frame bounding-box size of the object, and the coefficient of variation CV = σ / μ \mathrm{CV}=\sigma/\mu of the size sequence is computed, with SAM 3 segmentation ensuring the same object corresponds across frames. Smaller CV means more stable relative scale.
blocks.zh: VGGT - 堆积 \ Omega 估计对象的跨框架绑定框大小, 变量 CV = comption / suit\ mathrm{ CV}=\sigma /\mu 大小序列的比值, SAM 3 分割值确保同一对象对齐跨框架 。 较小的CV表示相对规模更稳定.

blocks.en: Any6D estimates the six-degree-of-freedom pose of the object; combined with VGGT- Ω \Omega geometry, Qwen3.8-27B compares whether the final pose change matches the known pose change specified by the prompt; the higher the match, the higher the score.
blocks.zh: Any6D估计对象的六度配位;结合VGGT-配位\Omega几何,Quen3.8-27B比较最终的姿势变化是否与提示指定的已知姿势变化相匹配;匹配越高,得分越高.

blocks.en: VGGT- Ω \Omega back-projects to obtain the 3D coordinates of object centroids, computes the relative position and distance between objects, and compares consistency with the spatial relation described by the prompt (above/below/left/right/front/back/containment, etc.). Consistent gives a high score.
blocks.zh: VGGT - 堆积 \ Omega back- 堆积, 以获取对象中间行星的 3D 坐标, 计算对象之间的相对位置和距离, 并与提示( 上/ 下/ 左/ 右/ 前/ 前/ 后/ 娱乐等) 描述的空间关系进行比较 。 一致给予高分。

blocks.en: On the one hand, VGGT- Ω \Omega independently reconstructs point clouds for adjacent frames and computes the cross-frame Chamfer drift (relaxed for the VGGT- Ω \Omega reconstruction noise baseline); on the other hand, FlowSeek computes the coefficient of variation CV of the average endpoint error AEPE of per-frame optical flow. Both smaller indicate more stable cross-frame geometry.
blocks.zh: 一方面,VGGT- complete \ Omega 独立对相邻框架的点云进行比对,并计算跨框架的Chamfer漂移(为 VGGT-\Omega 重建噪声基线松动);另一方面,FlowSeek 计算每帧光学流的平均端点误差AEPE 的变数CV的比值. 两者较小都表明跨框几何比较稳定.

blocks.en: Per-frame point clouds reconstructed by VGGT- Ω \Omega , combined with the object trajectory of SpatialTracker V2, after Kabsch alignment [ 18 ] compute the normalized Chamfer distance or rigid-body distance change rate to measure deformation; the threshold is higher than the VGGT- Ω \Omega reconstruction noise baseline (about 0.08 to 0.15) to avoid mistaking reconstruction noise for deformation. A smaller change rate means closer to rigid body.
blocks.zh: 由 VGGT- complete\ Omega 组合而成的每帧点云, 与 completeTracker V2 的对象对齐, 在 Kabsch 校正 [18] 计算 completed Chamfer 距离或刚性- body 距离变化率以测量变形; 阈值高于 VT-\ Omega 重建噪声基准( 约 0.08 到 ) 以避免错误地将重建噪声用于变形 。 较小的改变率意味着更接近刚性体.

blocks.en: Qwen3.8-27B performs a five-dimensional material check on the video (material category, hardness/softness, translucency, reflectivity, surface texture), judging item by item whether it conforms to physical commonsense. All dimensions reasonable gives a high score.
blocks.zh: 文选3.8-27 B对视频进行五维材料检查(材料类别、硬度/软度、透明性、反射性、表面纹理),按项目判断是否符合物理常识。 所有维度合理给出高分.

blocks.en: Qwen3.8-27B performs a five-dimensional radiation check (heat source identification, heat conduction direction, heat-induced luminescence/color change, thermal convection/updraft, no abnormal radiation from low-temperature objects), judging item by item whether it conforms to thermodynamic laws. Conforming gives a high score.
blocks.zh: 文选3.8-27 B进行五维辐射检查(热源识别,热传导方向,热引起的发光/颜色变化,热对流/升空,低温物体无异常辐射),逐项判断其是否符合热力学定律. Conforming给出了高分.

blocks.en: ReasonX estimates the back-inferred light source direction of each object, combined with the normal of StableNormal, computes the variance of the back-inferred light source directions of each object in the same scene and the photometric/shadow-position residual (degrees); the smaller the variance and residual, the more self-consistent the light/shadow is spatially.
blocks.zh: 原因 X估计每个物体的背向光源方向,结合StableNormal的正常情况,计算同一场景中每个物体的背向光源方向和光度/阴影位置残值(度)的差异;差异和残值越小,光度/阴影的自成一体性就越强.

blocks.en: Qwen3.8-27B judges the correctness of electromagnetic/electrostatic phenomena in the video (like poles repel and unlike poles attract, the effect of the magnetic field on ferromagnetic objects, electrostatic adsorption of light small objects, the arc of the Van de Graaff generator along field lines, tip discharge, etc.). Correct phenomena give a high score.
blocks.zh: Quen3.8-27B判断视频中电磁/静电现象的正确性(如电杆击退和不像电杆吸引,磁场对铁磁物体的影响,轻小物体的静电吸附,范德格拉夫发电机的弧沿场线,尖端放电等). 正确现象给出了很高的分数.

blocks.en: ReasonX estimates the main light direction L ⁡ ( t ) L(t) , and after camera-motion compensation to the world coordinate system, checks its temporal stability (degrees); the more stable the direction, the more consistent the light/shadow is temporally.
blocks.zh: 原因 X估计主要光线方向LQQ(t)L(t),在镜头-运动对世界坐标系统进行补偿后,检查其时间稳定性(度);方向越稳定,光/阴影越一致是时间上的.

blocks.en: Qwen3.8-27B judges the correctness of the phase transition process (conditions and direction of solid, liquid, and gas transition, temperature change due to latent heat, volume/morphology changes accompanying phase transition, etc.). A reasonable process gives a high score.
blocks.zh: Quen3.8-27B判断相位过渡过程的正确性(固体、液体和气体过渡的条件和方向、潜在热引起的温度变化、相位过渡伴随的体积/形态变化等)。 一个合理的过程给出了很高的分数.

blocks.en: SpatialTracker V2 (injecting query points with SAM 3 masks to obtain the object centroid trajectory) computes the L2 norm ‖ x ⁡ ( t ) ‖ 2 \|x(t)\|_{2} (meters) of the object worldline, and SAM 3 detects whether the object suddenly appears/disappears and the symmetry of collision rebound. A trajectory consistent with physical expectation gives a high score.

The object centroid trajectory of SpatialTracker V2 computes velocity and the second derivative for acceleration, compared with the physical expectation for velocity error ‖ 𝐯 − 𝐯 ^ ‖ \|\mathbf{v}-\hat{\mathbf{v}}\| (m/s), with 24 fps as the time base. Smaller error is better.
blocks.zh: SpaceTracker V2 计算速度和加速的第二个衍生物的物体中心行星轨迹,与对速度错误的物理预期 QQ v − v ^ ^ mathbf{v} -\hat\ mathbf{v}}\| (m/s) 相比,以24 fps为时间基. 比较小的差错

blocks.en: Any6D estimates the object rotation, combined with VGGT- Ω \Omega geometry to compute the angular velocity error ‖ ω − ω ^ ‖ \|\omega-\hat{\omega}\| (rad/s), and additionally computes the coefficient of variation CV of angular velocity under free rotation (free rotation should be constant). Smaller error and CV are better.

VFIMamba and SpatialTracker V2 reconstruct odd frames by interpolating even frames and compare with the real odd frames to obtain the interpolation error, and simultaneously compute the jerk (rate of change of acceleration) of the 3D trajectory; smaller error and jerk mean more continuous motion.
blocks.zh: VFIMamba 和空间跟踪器 V2通过内插偶数帧和与真实的奇数帧比较来重建奇数帧,以获得内插误差,同时计算3D轨迹的混蛋(加速变化速率);较小的误差和混蛋意味着更连续的运动.

blocks.en: SAM 3 segmentation and VGGT- Ω \Omega geometry, combined with Qwen3.8-27B semantics, check whether object identity is maintained in the “move away then move back” scene, whether the depth front-back order constitutes a legal occlusion, and count the number of tracking ID jumps. Stable ID and no illegal occlusion give a high score.
blocks.zh: SAM 3 分区和 VGGT - 组合 \Omega 几何,结合 Qwen3. 8-27B 语义,检查对象身份是否在"移动后移回"的场景中保持,深度前置顺序是否构成合法的隔离,并计算跟踪ID跳跃的次数. 稳定身份证明和非法隔离没有给出高分.

blocks.en: VGGT- Ω \Omega gives the depth point cloud, RANSAC [ 13 ] fits the support plane, and SAM 3 locates the bottom contact point of the object and checks whether the center-of-mass projection of the object falls within the support polygon; inside the polygon means stable, otherwise it may tip over.
blocks.zh: VGGT- 堆积\ Omega 给出深度点云, RANSAC [13] 匹配支持平面, SAM 3 定位对象的底端接触点, 并检查对象的质量中心投影是否属于支持多边形; 多边形内部表示稳定, 否则它可能倾斜 。

blocks.en: Prompt-specific, scale-invariant checks cover Newton’s first law, Galilean relativity, projectile motion, support contact, inclined-plane friction, sliding deceleration, bounce restitution, circular motion, and rolling. Metric scale from Depth Anything 3 is used to check acceleration against gravity. The residuals are aggregated into a score; smaller residuals are better.
blocks.zh: 快速的、规模化的检查覆盖了牛顿的第一定律、加利利相对论、抛射运动、支持接触、倾角飞机摩擦、滑动减速、反弹还原、循环运动和滚动。 从深度任意3的度量衡用于检查加速度与重力. 残基归集为分数;较小的残基较好.

blocks.en: SpatialTracker V2 and SAM 3 obtain the object trajectory before and after collision. The mass ratio is directly specified in the prompt, and we compute the momentum residual e = ‖ 𝐩 − 𝐩 ^ ‖ / ‖ 𝐩 ‖ e=\|\mathbf{p}-\hat{\mathbf{p}}\|/\|\mathbf{p}\| accordingly. Smaller residual is better.
blocks.zh: 空间跟踪仪V2和SAM 3在碰撞前后获得天体轨迹. 质量比在即时直接指定,我们按此计算动力残基 e = ‖ p = ^ p = ‖ p / ‖ mathbf{p} -\hat\ mathbf{p}}\|/\|\ mathbf{p}\|}。 更小的残留更好。

blocks.en: SpatialTracker V2, SAM 3, and the metric scale of Depth Anything 3 anchor the normalized coordinates to meters. The masses are obtained from the mass ratio specified in the prompt, so that kinetic energy KE \mathrm{KE} and potential energy PE = g ​ h \mathrm{PE}=gh can be computed without ambiguity; conservative scenarios should be approximately constant, and friction-involving scenarios should decrease monotonically and not rise spontaneously. The less deviation from constant/monotonic, the better.
blocks.zh: SpaceTracker V2, SAM 3, 以及深度 Anything 3 的度量尺度将正态坐标锁定到米. 质量是从当量中指定的质量比得到的,这样动能KE\mathrm{KE}和潜在能量PE=gh\mathrm{PE}=gh就可以毫不含糊地计算出来;保守的情景应该大致不变,而涉及摩擦的情景应该单调减少,而不是自发上升. 与常数/数论的偏差越小越好.

blocks.en: Mapping Physical Quantities to 1 to 5 Scores
blocks.zh: 将物理量绘图到1至5分

blocks.en: Table A15 gives the 1 to 5 threshold segments for each physical quantity. The mapping rule is unified: for quantities where “smaller is better” (direction ↓ \downarrow ), values successively below the 1st/2nd/3rd/4th segment threshold get 5/4/3/2 points, otherwise 1 point; for quantities where “larger is better” (direction ↑ \uparrow ), values successively above the corresponding threshold get 5/4/3/2 points. Without simulation GT (T2V/I2V setting), geometric dimensions are mapped by the above rule using the physical quantities output by specialized models (e.g., R01 depth-order accuracy, R02 normal-depth consistency, R03 normalized Chamfer), while semantic/scale/pose dimensions (R04/R06/R07/R10/R14/R25, etc.) are directly given 1 to 5 by Qwen3.8-27B; the thresholds also connect to the rationality conventions of geometric evaluation (e.g., R02 normal-depth consistency takes 15 ∘ 15^{\circ} as good), and relax the reconstruction noise baseline of specialized models (e.g., R05/R19).
blocks.zh: 表A15列出了每个物理量的1至5个阈值段。 绘图规则是统一的:对于“较小”的数值(方向 \\ downarrow ),相继低于1/2/nd/3rd/4分界阈值得到5/4/3/2分,否则得到1分;对于“较大”的数值(方向 \\ oparrow ),相继高于相应阈值的数值得到5/4/3/2分。 没有模拟GT(T2V/I2V设置),那么几何维度就由上述规则使用专用模型的物理量输出来绘制(如R01深度序精度,R02正常深度一致性,R03正常化的Chamfer),而语义/尺度/pose维度(R04/R06/R07/R10/R14/R25等)则由Qune3.8-27B直接给出1至5;阈值也与几何评价的合理性常规相连接(如R02正常深度一致性需要15∘15^{\circ}),并放松专用模型的重建噪声基线(如R05/R19).

blocks.en: Table A15 : Mapping of physical quantities to threshold segments and 1 to 5 scores. Thresholds for each segment are listed in the order “5 points to 1 point”; DIR marks the direction ( ↓ \downarrow smaller is better, ↑ \uparrow larger is better).
blocks.zh: 表A15:将物理数量映射到阈值段和1至5分. 每一段的阈值按“5分到1分”的顺序列出;DIR标出方向(小于\\微,大于\微).

blocks.en: Scoring Principles for Semantic and Perceptual Dimensions
blocks.zh: 语义和观念层面的协调原则

blocks.en: D1 to D3 do not extract numerical physical quantities, but are directly scored by specialized perception models or MLLM with 1 to 5 semantic/numerical anchors, explained per dimension below.
blocks.zh: D1到D3不提取数字物理量,而是直接通过专门的感知模型或MLLM得到1到5个语义/数字锚,按下面的维度解释.

blocks.en: Qwen3.8-27B judges whether the generated video contains the subject object specified by the prompt, assisted by CLIP/DINO objective reference scores; complete subject gives a high score.
blocks.zh: Quen3.8-27B判断生成的视频中是否包含由快报指定的主题对象,并由CLIP/DINO客观参考分数协助;完整主题给出高分.

blocks.en: Qwen3.8-27B checks whether the attributes of the subject, such as color, material, and quantity, are consistent with the prompt (including color matching); if consistent, it gives a high score.
blocks.zh: 文选3.8-27 乙级 检查对象的属性,如颜色,材料,和数量,是否与提示(包括颜色匹配)一致;如果一致,则给出高分.

blocks.en: Qwen3.8-27B judges whether the spatial relations between objects (above/below/left/right/front/back/containment, etc.) conform to the prompt; conforming gives a high score.
blocks.zh: Quen3.8-27B判断物体之间的空间关系(上/下/左/右/前/后/闭塞等)是否符合提示;符合给出了很高的分数.

blocks.en: Qwen3.8-27B judges whether the artistic/appearance style of the frame conforms to the prompt; conforming gives a high score.
blocks.zh: 文选3.8-27 B判断画框的艺术/出现风格是否符合提示;符合给出的评分很高.

blocks.en: Qwen3.8-27B checks whether the negation constraints in the prompt (e.g., “no X”, “Y does not appear”) are obeyed; obeying gives a high score.
blocks.zh: 文选3.8-27 乙级 检查是否遵守了“提示”中的否定性限制(例如“不X”、“Y不出现”);遵守给予高分。

blocks.en: Qwen3.8-27B judges whether the overall scene/environment is consistent with the scene described by the prompt; consistent gives a high score.
blocks.zh: Qwen3.8-27B判断整体场景/环境是否与快报描述的场景一致;一致给出了高分.

blocks.en: Qwen3.8-27B judges whether the camera motion (push/pull/pan/move/orbit, etc.) conforms to the prompt; conforming gives a high score.
blocks.zh: Qwen3.8-27B判断相机运动(推/推/泛/移动/轨道等)是否符合速率;符合时给出高分.

blocks.en: Evaluated only for I2V; aggregated from reference-image fidelity sub-indicators by DINOv3 + CLIP: IF-10a scene structure fidelity (DINOv3 feature similarity from reference image to first frame), IF-10c color/style continuity (DINOv3 Gram-matrix style distance, degraded to histogram KL divergence), IF-10d character face consistency (DINOv3 fine-feature tracking from reference image to video frame); higher fidelity gives a high score.
blocks.zh: 仅对I2V进行了评价;由DINOv3 + CLIP从参考图像忠义子指标中汇总:IF-10a场景结构忠义(DINOv3的特征从参考图像到第一帧相似),IF-10c色彩/风格连续性(DINOv3 Gram-matrix风格距离,退化为直方图KL差异),IF-10d人物面容一致性(DINOv3精细跟踪从参考图像到视频帧);更高的忠义给出了高分.

blocks.en: Qwen3.8-27B judges whether the action of the person/object conforms to the prompt (including human actions); conforming gives a high score.
blocks.zh: Qwen3.8-27B判断人/对象的行为是否符合即时(包括人的行动);符合给予高分.

blocks.en: Qwen3.8-27B judges whether the event timing conforms to the prompt (including temporal semantics); conforming gives a high score.
blocks.zh: Qwen3.8-27B判断事件时间是否符合即时(包括时语义);符合给出高分.

blocks.en: Adopts counterfactual action pairs: generate two versions of the video, “with action” and “without action”, for the same scene; SpatialTracker V2 tracks the 3D trajectory of the object, quantifies the causal effect (displacement amplification ratio, direction consistency), and then Qwen3.8-27B semantically verifies whether the result is reasonable; both effect and semantics reasonable give a high score.
blocks.zh: 通过反事实动作配对:为同一场景生成两个版本的视频,"有动作"和"无动作";SpaceTracker V2跟踪物体的3D轨迹,量化因果(异位放大比,方向一致性),然后由Quen3.8-27B对结果是否合理进行映射验证;效果和语义都合理给予高分.

blocks.en: Qwen3.8-27B multiple-choice judgment plus explanatory reasonableness scoring, examining basic physical intuition (heavy objects fall, light objects float, fire rises, water flows down, shadow direction, etc.); reasonable gives a high score.
blocks.zh: 文选3.8-27 B 多重选择判断加上解释性合理性评分,检查基本物理直觉(重物坠落,轻物漂浮,火起,水流向下,阴影方向等);合理给予高分.

blocks.en: Qwen3.8-27B judges the reasonableness of biological behavior (animal movement patterns, plant growth direction, human pose naturalness, etc.); reasonable gives a high score.
blocks.zh: Qune3.8-27B判断生物行为的合理性(动物运动规律,植物生长方向,人类姿势自然等);合理性给予高分.

blocks.en: Qwen3.8-27B judges the reasonableness of scene logic (table and chair placement, naturalness of character interaction, daily causal consistency, etc.); reasonable gives a high score.
blocks.zh: Quen3.8-27B判断场景逻辑的合理性(表和椅子布置,人物互动的自然性,日常因果一致性等);合理性给出了高分.

blocks.en: DINOv3 computes the cosine similarity of subject features between adjacent frames, mapped to 1 to 5 (threshold in Table A15 ); higher similarity is better.
blocks.zh: DINOv3计算相邻框架之间主题特征的余弦相似性,映射到1至5(阈值在表A15 中);更高的相似性更好.

blocks.en: FineVQ [ 11 ] (CVPR 2025, InternVL2-8B + regression head) scores the video aesthetic quality; the raw regression value is calibrated to 1 to 5 by distribution quantiles; higher score is better.
blocks.zh: FineVQ [11] (CVPR 2025, InternVL2-8B +回归头)对视频美学质量进行评分;原始回归值通过发行量的四分数校准为1至5;得分较高更好.

blocks.en: OpenCV/Farneback [ 3 , 12 ] optical flow computes motion acceleration smoothness max ⁡ ( 0 , 1 − average acceleration / 2 ) \max(0,1-\text{average acceleration}/2) , mapped to 1 to 5 (threshold in Table A15 ); smoother is better.
blocks.zh: OpenCV/Farneback [3, 12] 光学流计算运动加速平滑度最大 QQ( 0, 1 - 平均加速度 / 2)\max( 0, 1-\ text{ 平均加速度 }/2), 映射到 1 到 5( 表 A15 中的阈值); 更平滑更好 。

blocks.en: Measured by pixel differences in static regions of adjacent frames; smaller difference is better, mapped to 1 to 5.
blocks.zh: 以相邻框架的静态区域像素差异测量;较小的差异较好,映射到1至5.

blocks.en: Measured by the optical flow magnitude distribution; being consistent with the dynamic expectation of the prompt gives a high score.
blocks.zh: 以光学流度分布来测量;符合对急速的动态预期,给出了很高的分数.

blocks.en: CLIP computes the cosine similarity of background features between adjacent frames, mapped to 1 to 5 (threshold in Table A15 ); higher similarity is better.
blocks.zh: CLIP计算相邻框架之间背景特征的余弦相似性,映射到1至5(阈值在表A15中);更高的相似性更好.

blocks.en: Measured by Laplacian sharpness and exposure reasonableness; higher quality is better.
blocks.zh: 以拉普拉西安的锐度和暴露合理性来衡量;质量更高更好.

blocks.en: Appendix E Additional Prompt-Set Statistics
blocks.zh: 附录E 其他即时统计

blocks.en: The dataset contains 600 prompt groups, each paired with T2V and I2V versions. Table A16 summarizes their composition and the share of embodied scenarios.
blocks.zh: 数据集包含600个即时组,每个组与T2V和I2V版本对齐. 表A16总结了它们的构成和在各种设想中所占的份额。

blocks.en: Table A16 : Statistics of the 600 prompt groups: category counts, embodied samples, and modality pairing.
blocks.zh: 表A16:600个速成组的统计:类别计数、包含样本和模式配对。

blocks.en: Appendix F Generation Protocol Details
blocks.zh: 附录F 生成 协议细节

blocks.en: All models generate all 600 prompt groups one by one. T2V is conditioned on text, I2V is conditioned on the first-frame reference image synthesized by GPT-image-2, ensuring T2V/I2V share the same initial scene (see main text Section 3.2 ). The unified output specification is 720p, about 10 seconds (about 240 frames, 24 fps), with a fixed random seed; each model uses its officially recommended inference configuration and weights. Generated videos are uniformly resampled to the resolution and frame rate required by the evaluators before evaluation. The generation scripts, model versions, and hyperparameters will be released with the code to support third-party reproducibility.
blocks.zh: 所有模型都逐个生成所有600个快速组. T2V以文本为条件,I2V以GPT-image-2合成的第一帧参考图像为条件,确保T2V/I2V共享相同的初始场景(见正文第3.2节). 统一输出规格为720p,约10秒(约240帧,24英尺),有固定的随机种子;每个模型使用其官方推荐的推论配置和权重. 生成的视频统一复制到评估者在评价前所要求的分辨率和帧率. 生成脚本,模型版本,和超参数将随代码一同发布,以支持第三方复制.

blocks.en: Appendix G Evaluation Cost and Reproducibility
blocks.zh: 附录G 评价费用和可复制性

blocks.en: For reproducibility, the versions and weights of specialized models and the random seed are fixed during evaluation. The experiments cover 12 model configurations and 600 prompt groups (about 7,200 videos); the evaluation models run on a single H20 GPU (95 GB). Per-video runtime and total GPU hours vary with hardware and the evaluated dimensions. Further statistics, the runtime environment, and model-weight versions will be provided with the code release.
blocks.zh: 对于可复制性,专业模型和随机种子的版本和权重在评价期间固定. 实验涵盖12个模型配置和600个即时组(约7,200个视频);评价模型运行在单H20 GPU(95 GB)上. Per-video运行时间和GPU总时数随硬件和评价的维度而变化. 进一步的统计资料、运行时间环境和模型重量版本将得到代码发布。
